purpose: Teach: 有馬/松浦/コウ/シイ/コリア/ダスト/クローバー/チェア

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが有馬温泉のお土産を下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought back a souvenir from Arima hot springs.
lines.style: Warm announcement tinged with gentle knowing. Soft delivery, slight lift in the middle. Voice carries affection for both the gift and the gesture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと長崎県松浦の歴史本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a history book about Matsuura in Nagasaki.
lines.style: Bright, clear voice without forced enthusiasm. Direct eye contact. Pride in the shared activity — not performing, reporting something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコウさんとお茶会されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is having tea with Kou right now.
lines.style: Gentle observation, voice slightly distant but not cold. Noticing something about the moment — the presence of these small, good things happening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシイたけ栽培キット買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought a shiitake mushroom growing kit together.
lines.style: Quick, genuine excitement. Natural cadence, no exaggeration. The small joy of something concrete to build toward with his father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコリア、つまり韓国料理を作って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is making Korean food for us.
lines.style: Soft statement of fact wrapped in quiet appreciation. A slight emphasis on the care in the gesture — not announcing, noticing aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとダストフリーの空気清浄機買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought a dust-free air purifier.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with underlying contentment. Small voice, steady. The happiness is in the action itself, not in telling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが四つ葉のクローバーを押し花にして下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is pressing four-leaf clovers to keep them.
lines.style: Voice softens on the image. Slow, deliberate pacing. A moment of recognizing something tender — the preservation of small, lucky moments.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと折りたたみチェアで公園ピクニックしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had a picnic in the park with folding chairs.
lines.style: Warm, settling conclusion. Slower pace, voice trailing with contentment. The final detail — the simplicity of it — is where the happiness lives.
